root_causes.mixing: 0.16.2 forced Web auto regardless of the nonexclusive preference; real Web media can select exclusive MediaPlayback with no mixing option. UI-process AVAudioSession.mixWithOthers does not enforce the Web process category.
root_causes.fullscreen_notice: WKFullScreenViewController adds the standard Element Fullscreen warning banner. No public disable setting.
root_causes.credential_warning: PasswordSuggestionBar still displayed a catch-path alert, and manager fill used the general error reporter, despite the earlier successful-ACK/focus fix.

implementation.mixing: Restore Web ambient when both existing mixing prefs are on, auto otherwise. Embed initial preference in document-start script and refresh only owned future scripts; restore current preference on return. Preserve native playback+mixWithOthers, capture priority, explicit pause/mute/zero and bounded background behavior.
implementation.fullscreen: Page API adapter routes video requests to original video legacy native fullscreen; other elements use original-node Popover/CSS top layer with parent iframe relay and attributes/style/scroll restoration. No source extraction, replacement, reparenting, private banner APIs or forced play. Native origin+close UI remains for app-window mode; credentials disabled there; exit restores browser controls immediately even if page JS is busy. Fullscreen-related page alert notices also complete silently.
implementation.passwords: Remove inline fill catch alert, suppress manager-fill error reporting, remove missing-record/form notices; automatic fill remains silent. Preserve authentication, origin/form/privacy checks and save/import/backup errors.

verification_policy.user_preference: Carry forward the immediately preceding instruction to perform device testing themselves and release without long UI automation.
verification_policy.release_workflow: One-time build114 Release device build/inspection/publish/delivery only; removed after delivery, normal ios.yml unchanged.

checks.web_audio_policy: passed; initial nonexclusive setting/toggles/foreground signals/background ownership+restore/capture/pause/mute; AudioSession is mocked, not hardware audio proof
checks.quiet_fullscreen: passed in Chromium: two real CSS/popover full-window cycles at420x840, original real H264/AAC video/time retained across entry/exit, styles restored, cross-origin child/parent iframe expansion+exit; native video calls mocked for routing and zero Element Fullscreen calls

limits: WebKit ambient mixes but obeys Silent; universal simultaneous mixing and Silent override cannot be guaranteed through public WKWebView APIs. The settings UI and release notes disclose this.

Actual iPhone other-app speaker mixing, native video/popover presentation, supplied-site notices and password acceptance await user testing. No completed native UI or Core unit-test run is claimed for this release.
